text: At its meeting on March 23, 2026, the Confronting Anti-Black Racism Advisory Committee considered item CR9.3 and made recommendations to Economic and Community Development Committee and City Council.

The Economic and Community Development Committee: 1. Referred Item EC27.12 to the Deputy City Manager, Community Development and Social Services for consideration as part of the upcoming Toronto Neighbourhood Assessment Framework report and to include in the report back how the Inclusive Economic Development framework, Data for Equity, Community Development Plans, and local community leadership capacity building strengthen community development.
